---

**Code signing policy:** see the [NexurBots README](https://github.com/nexurlabs/nexur-bots#code-signing-policy). NexurBots uses SignPath Foundation for code signing: Windows installers are signed for free by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io), with a certificate issued by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org), once the project's application is approved. Until then the installer is unsigned.
